Probes and conditional tactics

Source: R/tactics.R
z3_probe.Rd

A probe measures a goal and returns a number (Booleans are 1 or 0), such as "num-consts", "size" or "is-qflia". z3_probes() lists them. Probes compare and combine with <, >, <=, >=, ==, &, | and !; numbers are turned into constant probes.

Usage

z3_probe(ctx, name)

z3_probes(ctx)

z3_probe_apply(p, goal)

z3_tactic_when(p, t)

z3_tactic_cond(p, t1, t2)

z3_tactic_fail_if(p)

z3_tactic_skip(ctx)

z3_tactic_fail(ctx)

z3_tactic_fail_if_not_decided(ctx)

z3_tactic_par_or(...)

z3_tactic_par_then(t1, t2)

z3_tactic_with(t, ...)

z3_tactic_params(t)

Arguments

ctx

A z3_context().

name

Probe name.

p

A z3_probe.

goal

A z3_goal.

t, t1, t2

z3_tactic objects.

...

Tactics for z3_tactic_par_or(); named parameters for z3_tactic_with().

Value

A z3_probe, a z3_tactic, a number (z3_probe_apply()), or a data frame (z3_probes(), z3_tactic_params()).

Details

  • z3_tactic_when(p, t) applies t when the probe is true and skips otherwise; z3_tactic_cond(p, t1, t2) chooses between two tactics; z3_tactic_fail_if(p) fails when the probe is true.

  • z3_tactic_skip(), z3_tactic_fail() and z3_tactic_fail_if_not_decided() are the trivial tactics.

  • z3_tactic_par_or() runs tactics in parallel and keeps the first to succeed; z3_tactic_par_then(t1, t2) applies t2 to every subgoal of t1 in parallel.

  • z3_tactic_with() fixes parameters of a tactic; z3_tactic_params() lists them.

Parallel tactics run inside Z3 on Z3's own threads; R is not involved.

Examples

ctx <- z3_context()
x <- z3_int(ctx, "x")
g <- z3_goal(ctx)
z3_add(g, x > 0, x < 10)
z3_probe_apply(z3_probe(ctx, "num-consts"), g)
#> [1] 1
small <- z3_probe(ctx, "size") < 5
t <- z3_tactic_cond(small, z3_tactic(ctx, "smt"), z3_tactic(ctx, "skip"))
z3_apply_tactic(t, g)
#> <z3_apply_result: 1 subgoal>
#> (goals
#> (goal)
#> )
